outcome: Closure reads the live checklist, Finance confirms milestone notifications, and the Head of PMO closes or returns the project
acceptance_criteria: Open `/projects/<case>/delivery` Closure step for dossier 5001 on Next 4990 with mock 4991: tag "Closure · Not yet"; eight rows (go-live, hypercare, archive, handover, retrospective, finance, scope, report) with the live titles; retrospective shows "Not yet" and the finding; finance shows "Unknown"; no Tola card, no "Ask Tola", no "read-only" text — verify: page and DOM; `frontend/e2e/delivery-closure.spec.ts`.

The same step against Django 8030 for a real dossier shows the same titles, statuses and findings as `GET /api/v1/projects/{case}/delivery/{dossier}/closure-checklist` — verify: compare with `oa.py`/`curl` JSON using the session.
A status of `unknown` or `unavailable` is never drawn as Done; `held` shows its `finding` — verify: unit test on the check mapper (all six statuses).

Dossier 5002 (ready, no work) shows "Start closure"; dossier 5001 (not ready, no work) shows none — verify: e2e; the button posts `POST /work` with `line:"delivery-closure/v1"` and `intake.dossier_id` and a 201 reloads the page — verify: network panel.
Start work options come from `intake-sources?line=delivery-closure/v1`; paging uses `next_before`; no field offers a generic file upload for evidence — verify: unit test and network panel.
Dossier 5004 as the Head of PMO shows "Close the project" and "Return with a note"; the Return button stays disabled until a note is typed — verify: e2e.

Pressing "Close the project" sends exactly one `POST /work/4302/reviews` with `kind:"closure"`, `verdict:"approve"`, `expected_revision`, `case_revision`, `version_id`, `evidence_id`, `note`, and no claim call; the page then shows the closed state from the re-read — verify: network panel and e2e asserting the body.
"Return with a note" sends `verdict:"return"` with the typed note; the page then shows the returned state with the note from history — verify: e2e.
A viewer with `can_decide:false` (dossier 5003) sees no decision buttons and "The PMO Lead decides on closure." — verify: e2e.

A null `revision` or `case_revision` disables the decision buttons with "Reload to continue" and sends nothing; a missing `version_id`/`evidence_id` disables them with the "isn't ready to decide yet" text — verify: unit test on the descriptor and e2e.

A 409 on the decision re-reads work and checklist, shows "This changed. Review the latest report.", and does not repeat the write; a double click sends one request — verify: mock scenario `409` plus fetch-count unit test.
A 403 `csrf_failed` refreshes the session once and says "Press again"; no automatic second write — verify: unit test counts fetches.

A 403 (not csrf) on the decision shows "You can't decide this closure." and no reason; a 404 shows "This record is unavailable." identical to a missing record — verify: mock scenarios; compare the text.

Returned state (5005) shows who returned, the date and the note from the latest closure history row; with no such row the sentence is absent, not invented — verify: e2e on 5005 and on a variant without history.

"Replace the report" sends `POST /work/{id}/closure-report` with `previous_evidence_id` from the `report` check, text up to 16 000 characters (counter, 16 001 refused before sending); 201 shows the new report id and re-reads — verify: unit and e2e; 413 shows "The report is too long."

The Finance block appears for a Finance user on dossier 5003 with milestones listed; for a non-Finance viewer (mock 403 on the read) it is absent with no message, and the rest of the page loads — verify: e2e as both users; wrong tenant or unknown dossier gives the 404 wording.
Confirm is disabled until the completeness checkbox, an evidence id and a note are set, and always when `finding` is not null (shown as the reason) — verify: e2e.

Confirm sends `POST .../finance-confirmation` `{revision, milestone_ids (all listed), inventory_complete:true, evidence_id, note}`; 201 re-reads both reads and the finance row becomes "Confirmed"; 409 says "Finance confirmation changed. Review it again." and re-reads — verify: network panel and e2e.
No text on the page says debts are confirmed; the finance row and form say "milestone notifications" — verify: grep of the feature folder and DOM text for 5003/5004.

Dossier 5006 (closed) shows "Still open after closure" from `debt.items`, "As of 2026-11-20", an `owed:null` item as "Amount not recorded" (never 0 or blank), and "List is limited" when `limited:true` — verify: e2e and unit test on the debt mapper.
A viewer whose `debt` is null sees no "Still open" section and no placeholder; `items:[]` shows "No open invoices recorded as of <date>." — verify: unit and e2e.
The closed state does not say the project is read-only or moved to Closed in Projects, and has no "Support contract" row — verify: grep and DOM.
Each of 401, 429, 503 and a dropped network shows its mapped wording with Try again (reads) and keeps typed form text on a write failure — verify: mock scenarios.

`closureAdapter.ts` registers key `delivery-closure`, returns `Section[]` the existing renderer draws, and its three descriptors carry the tokens, `idempotency.field === null`, and a `null` token stays `null` in `body()` — verify: `closureAdapter.test.ts`.

No file under `frontend/src/features/workspace/` or `frontend/src/features/work-item/` is changed — verify: `git diff --stat origin/main -- frontend/src/features/workspace frontend/src/features/work-item` is empty.
Viewport check at 1440 and 390 against the ten SCR-49 artboards for the parts drawn; hidden parts leave no empty heading or gap — verify: screenshots reviewed against `design/screens.md` SCR-49.

Focus and keyboard: the decision and finance forms are reachable by Tab, errors are announced (role alert), the note field has a label, and the page has no `prefers-reduced-motion` animation — verify: e2e keyboard run and axe check.
`npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` pass and `api-live-schema-drift.test.ts` still passes — verify: `delivery/checks.sh`.

risk.rationale: High. Closing a project is hard to undo. Finance confirmation is a data-affecting write gated on Finance authority, and the debt figures are protected (D-25 to D-27). Two role gates (Head of PMO and Finance), two revision tokens and a recorded evidence proof raise concurrency and authority risk. The screen changes a flow and adds new copy, so the client must see it.

completion.reason: Project, readiness, implementation and review evidence has not been supplied.
